items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Kimery is identified in the notes as the 'recording engineer'. The interviewee mentions him only in the context of technical interruptions or metadata, with no evidence of a personal or professional musical relationship.

ctx.x: Yeah, I hear that the actual basement part is still, pretty much, as it was. But, I think they started out trying to do a lot of jazz things when they re-opened it but I don’t know how that has shaken out.
Yeah, I haven’t heard anything about it. Ken Kimery: They’ve actually been doing quite well.
Oh good! Good! Ken Kimery: Ron Carter has been in there. So, they’ve been making great strides.
